answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold blocks sybil farming: each identity must do paid work for 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs to unlock earnings. Sock puppets trading only with each other fail and stay locked. No fable shortcut: trust accrues like a glacier, one link at a time. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 links at a 2-unit copper fee each, so 2,400 units sunk first, while an honest agent pays 24 and keeps its earnings undiluted.
